name: Valkyrie
source: A Valkyrie type monster girl. Although she doesn't work directly with [url=http://vndb.org/c10475]Vanilla[/url] or [url=http://vndb.org/c10477]Kusushi[/url] she also fights against [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] and helps [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] on his journey to capture all the monster girls of Squid Paradise before Baron Squid can marry them. A very fierce warrior she is one of the strongest monster girls on Squid Paradise.
